delta: One monthly series per payer, joined on service month.

sql:
WITH months AS (
  SELECT DISTINCT date_trunc('month', service_date)::DATE AS service_month
  FROM sem.claims
),
aetna_monthly AS (
  SELECT date_trunc('month', service_date)::DATE AS service_month,
         COUNT(*) AS claims,
         SUM(charge_amount) AS charge_amount,
         SUM(paid_amount) AS paid_amount,
         SUM(CASE WHEN status = 'denied' THEN 1 ELSE 0 END) AS denied_claims,
         SUM(CASE WHEN status = 'partial' THEN 1 ELSE 0 END) AS partial_claims
  FROM sem.claims
  WHERE payer_name = 'Aetna'
  GROUP BY 1
),
bcbs_monthly AS (
  SELECT date_trunc('month', service_date)::DATE AS service_month,
         COUNT(*) AS claims,
         SUM(charge_amount) AS charge_amount,
         SUM(paid_amount) AS paid_amount,
         SUM(CASE WHEN status = 'denied' THEN 1 ELSE 0 END) AS denied_claims,
         SUM(CASE WHEN status = 'partial' THEN 1 ELSE 0 END) AS partial_claims
  FROM sem.claims
  WHERE payer_name = 'BCBS'
  GROUP BY 1
),
cigna_monthly AS (
  SELECT date_trunc('month', service_date)::DATE AS service_month,
         COUNT(*) AS claims,
         SUM(charge_amount) AS charge_amount,
         SUM(paid_amount) AS paid_amount,
         SUM(CASE WHEN status = 'denied' THEN 1 ELSE 0 END) AS denied_claims,
         SUM(CASE WHEN status = 'partial' THEN 1 ELSE 0 END) AS partial_claims
  FROM sem.claims
  WHERE payer_name = 'Cigna'
  GROUP BY 1
),
humana_monthly AS (
  SELECT date_trunc('month', service_date)::DATE AS service_month,
         COUNT(*) AS claims,
         SUM(charge_amount) AS charge_amount,
         SUM(paid_amount) AS paid_amount,
         SUM(CASE WHEN status = 'denied' THEN 1 ELSE 0 END) AS denied_claims,
         SUM(CASE WHEN status = 'partial' THEN 1 ELSE 0 END) AS partial_claims
  FROM sem.claims
  WHERE payer_name = 'Humana'
  GROUP BY 1
),
medicare_monthly AS (
  SELECT date_trunc('month', service_date)::DATE AS service_month,
         COUNT(*) AS claims,
         SUM(charge_amount) AS charge_amount,
         SUM(paid_amount) AS paid_amount,
         SUM(CASE WHEN status = 'denied' THEN 1 ELSE 0 END) AS denied_claims,
         SUM(CASE WHEN status = 'partial' THEN 1 ELSE 0 END) AS partial_claims
  FROM sem.claims
  WHERE payer_name = 'Medicare'
  GROUP BY 1
),
medicaid_monthly AS (
  SELECT date_trunc('month', service_date)::DATE AS service_month,
         COUNT(*) AS claims,
         SUM(charge_amount) AS charge_amount,
         SUM(paid_amount) AS paid_amount,
         SUM(CASE WHEN status = 'denied' THEN 1 ELSE 0 END) AS denied_claims,
         SUM(CASE WHEN status = 'partial' THEN 1 ELSE 0 END) AS partial_claims
  FROM sem.claims
  WHERE payer_name = 'Medicaid'
  GROUP BY 1
),
unitedhealthcare_monthly AS (
  SELECT date_trunc('month', service_date)::DATE AS service_month,
         COUNT(*) AS claims,
         SUM(charge_amount) AS charge_amount,
         SUM(paid_amount) AS paid_amount,
         SUM(CASE WHEN status = 'denied' THEN 1 ELSE 0 END) AS denied_claims,
         SUM(CASE WHEN status = 'partial' THEN 1 ELSE 0 END) AS partial_claims
  FROM sem.claims
  WHERE payer_name = 'UnitedHealthcare'
  GROUP BY 1
)
SELECT
  months.service_month,
  COALESCE(aetna_monthly.paid_amount, 0) AS paid_aetna,
  COALESCE(aetna_monthly.denied_claims, 0) AS denied_aetna,
  COALESCE(bcbs_monthly.paid_amount, 0) AS paid_bcbs,
  COALESCE(bcbs_monthly.denied_claims, 0) AS denied_bcbs,
  COALESCE(cigna_monthly.paid_amount, 0) AS paid_cigna,
  COALESCE(cigna_monthly.denied_claims, 0) AS denied_cigna,
  COALESCE(humana_monthly.paid_amount, 0) AS paid_humana,
  COALESCE(humana_monthly.denied_claims, 0) AS denied_humana,
  COALESCE(medicare_monthly.paid_amount, 0) AS paid_medicare,
  COALESCE(medicare_monthly.denied_claims, 0) AS denied_medicare,
  COALESCE(medicaid_monthly.paid_amount, 0) AS paid_medicaid,
  COALESCE(medicaid_monthly.denied_claims, 0) AS denied_medicaid,
  COALESCE(unitedhealthcare_monthly.paid_amount, 0) AS paid_unitedhealthcare,
  COALESCE(unitedhealthcare_monthly.denied_claims, 0) AS denied_unitedhealthcare
FROM months
LEFT JOIN aetna_monthly USING (service_month)
LEFT JOIN bcbs_monthly USING (service_month)
LEFT JOIN cigna_monthly USING (service_month)
LEFT JOIN humana_monthly USING (service_month)
LEFT JOIN medicare_monthly USING (service_month)
LEFT JOIN medicaid_monthly USING (service_month)
LEFT JOIN unitedhealthcare_monthly USING (service_month)
ORDER BY 1
